name: Platform packaging
summary: Check the video file, choose the cover frame and write the TikTok, Reels and Shorts post file with every limit, AI label, 18+ control and music credit checked.
qualityBar: The generator reproduces all 100 text blocks of the 20 existing post files byte for byte

A 141-character TikTok title, 7 hashtags, a banned word, a 101-character hook, a # in a link, AI music without credit or Instagram audio name, and tags over 500 are caught; a 140-character title passes
AEON posts carry the 18+ line on all three platforms and TikTok Audience controls On; BGI-only posts do not
Video check passes a full-size silent master and fails preview size, a master with sound and 24 fps
The cover for the ported tt10 and for the demo is a headline frame before the closer, 1080x1920 with a 1080x1440 3:4 grid file, identical bytes on a second run
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (49 checks passed, 0 failed).
